slides.texte_overlay:
How to be respected at the gym
without lifting heavy

1. Wipe the bench

Every time. Nobody wants
your sweat.

2. Don't camp on machines
at rush hour

Rest somewhere else.
Let others work in.

3. Headphones on means
don't interrupt

Unless it's a spot or
an emergency.

4. Never film other people

Their workout isn't
your content.

5. Show up at the same time
every week

Consistency is the flex
everyone notices.

6. Train your mind too

Rest days count.
Feed your head something good.
slides.texte_sophia:
6. Train your mind too

On rest days, I give
5 minutes to the Sophia app.
Feed your head something good.
